_readme: WHERE THE PRICE CATALOGUE IS DOWNLOADED FROM, shipped with the product as
data. It is here and not in Rust for the reason every other engine fact is:
a product that claims to know no provider must not carry one provider's
address in its code, and whoever wants another catalogue must be able to
point at it without a compiler.
`url` is asked with no authentication, so there is no key anywhere near
this file. `shape` says which reader understands the answer: today there is
one, and naming it is what lets a second arrive as data instead of as a
MODELS_CATALOGUE_SOURCE names a file read instead of this one, whole.
MODELS_CATALOG_FETCH_OVERRIDE replaces the download itself with any
command, which is how the tests reach both outcomes without a line.
